title: Handling Unauthorised VAS Subscription Complaints
content:
Handling Unauthorised VAS Subscription Complaints

Document ID: SOP_C10_VAS_DISPUTE

Category: C10 — Value Added Services (VAS)

Department: Product

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To ensure unauthorised Value Added Service (VAS) charges are investigated and refunded consistently, per consent-based subscription regulations.

Procedure

Pull the VAS activation log for the disputed service, including channel (SMS/USSD/WAP click/app) and timestamp.

If consent cannot be clearly evidenced, approve a full refund of charges for the disputed service.

Deactivate the VAS immediately regardless of the consent outcome, if the customer requests deactivation.

Log the activation channel for pattern analysis — repeated unconsented activations from a single VAS partner are escalated to Legal/Compliance.
